Stellar Blade | Multi Frame Gen + Latency Test (RTX 5060)

Experience Stellar Blade with NVIDIA’s latest Multi Frame Generation technology on the RTX 5060. This benchmark showcases frame generation performance and system latency using detailed real-time overlays. Ideal for gamers looking to evaluate smoothness, responsiveness, and frame consistency.

🖥 GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060
⚙️ Settings: Ultra Preset + Multi Frame Gen ON
📏 Metrics: FPS, Frame Times, System Latency, 1% Lows
📺 Recording: 1440p 60FPS (No upscaling)

 🔧 System Specifications:
- CPU: Intel i5-12400F (https://amzn.to/4eOlE4j)
- GPU: MSI GeForce RTX 4060 8GB OC (https://amzn.to/3XNOtbh)
- OS: Windows 11 Pro
- Storage: 500GB Crucial P3 Plus M.2 SSD (https://amzn.to/3MQv17g)
- HDD: 4TB WD Blue HDD (https://amzn.to/3ZuPDJW)
- Motherboard: ASRock H610M-HDV/M.2 (https://amzn.to/4egdfqs)
- Power Supply: Cooler Master 750w Gold (https://amzn.to/3Bl579e)
- RAM: Corsair 2x16GB 3200Mhz DDR4 (https://amzn.to/3XAdwgr)

🎥 Recorded with Elgato HD60X
